lesson.title: 7.4 It's raining
lesson.unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
lesson.unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
lesson.goal: Say what the weather is doing now with It's raining. / It's snowing. and ask Is it raining?.
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.4 The Weather Today: A1 describes the day with an adjective (It is rainy. It is sunny.) and A1 7.10 names rain and snow; A1+ 7.4 says what the weather is doing now. The one new grammar relationship is It's + raining/snowing (the weather as an action happening now), with the question Is it raining? / Is it snowing? and the short answers Yes, it is. / No, it isn't. from A1+ 3.4. 7.2's because and 7.3's wearing come back with the weather as the reason (Ana is wearing a hat because it's snowing.).
lesson.prerequisite: A1 7.4 rainy and sunny; A1 7.5 umbrella; A1 7.10 rain and snow; A1+ 3.4 short answers; A1+ 7.2 because; A1+ 7.3 wearing.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say raining and snowing with the stress on the first part (RAY-ning, SNOH-ing); in the question, let the voice go up at the end (Is it RAI-ning?). Do not require native-like speed.
